jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw
Interface Layout

All Known Subinterfaces:
PagedLayout
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractLayout, SimplePrinterLayout
public interface Layout

Elements of this class are responsible for computing the position and dimensions of view elements.

A layout can change a view's width and height and it can also change the subview positions and scales.

Important - note that layout does just that -- layout -- and does in no way create view elements. MDCView element creation is the task of ViewBuilder.

An actual base for implementation can be found in the SimpleLayout class.

Serge Rosmorduc

layout

public void layout(MDCView view,
                   DrawingSpecifications drawingSpecifications)
compute the view size (width and height). If the view has subviews, layout should compute their position in the parent view and scale them if required. Note that layout is not a recursive function : when a view is built, its subviews have already been processed by another call to layout.

Parameters:
view -

preLayoutHook

public void preLayoutHook(MDCView view)
This method is called before anything is done on the view. Most notably, it's called before the subviews are built. It might be used when the layout of the internal elements depends on their container. Currently, its main actual use is to change the sign centering preferences when laying out a cadrat.

Parameters:
view -
